feature_title: Dashboard Chart Zoom Brush & Panel Drag

rationale.edition: All 10 changed paths are under web/src/** and web/patches/** (the OSS frontend tree); none live in enterprise-owned directories (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/). No enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/logo) appear in the paths or changed symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. There is no tests-added label or skip comment (trigger_comment.txt is empty), and the change is user-facing: it alters dashboard chart rendering (zoom-brush fill) and panel drag interaction, not docs/CI/comment-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The diff changes the echarts v6 dataZoom brush fill to a shared translucent selection style and reworks dashboard panel drag (handle '.drag-allow' -> cancel '.drag-cancel'), so a user's chart zoom-brush visual and the header-only panel drag behavior are observable UI/interaction changes worth verifying in the browser.
rationale.area: Dashboards. The bulk of the changes live in web/src/views/Dashboards/, web/src/components/dashboards/, and web/src/utils/dashboard/** (plus shared chartTheme used by logs/traces/alerts converters); sibling E2E specs live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/.
rationale.group: Dashboards-Charts is the closest matrix shard: it holds chart-rendering specs (custom-charts, multi-y-axis, pie-donut, sankey, maps) under actual_folder 'Dashboards', matching this chart-rendering/interaction change better than the table/variables/config shards.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. No files under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ were changed; the only test-adjacent file is a node_modules echarts patch (web/patches/echarts+6.1.0.patch), which is not Playwright coverage.
